contract: Local retail research workspace; direct data editing and scaled floorplan canvas; primary save/run actions; desktop and narrow layouts with explicit input errors and persisted state.

accessibility.evidence: Axe WCAG A/AA returned zero violations on Dashboard and Floorplan Editor after contrast corrections. Playwright exercised labeled controls, keyboard focus and mobile menu. This is bounded coverage, not a full accessibility certification.

responsive.evidence: Playwright verified document width does not exceed viewport at 390px; desktop/mobile screenshots reviewed. Reduced motion emulated; editor ruler moved clear of edge labels and shelf dimensions shown on selection at narrow scales.

loading.evidence: Delayed projects response shows loading indicator and disables create until response completes.

empty.evidence: New project displays 0/7 completion and no run results.

error.evidence: Invalid negative aisle produces visible HTTP 422; reload confirms invalid draft was not persisted.

partial.evidence: Saving floorplan and shelves in a new project produces 2/7 completion without filling remaining groups.

success.evidence: Real worker succeeds, replay reproduces checksum in backend test, result viewers render, browser downloads report JSON.

permission.reason: Local single-user foundation has no authentication or roles. No permission request path is offered or claimed.

renderedEvidence.observation: Dashboard with persisted data completion and real successful run history.
Konva floorplan with measured edges, shelves, obstacle and editing controls.
Two-column KPI layout, stacked panels and mobile navigation without horizontal page overflow.
Wrapped toolbar, scaled canvas, separate ruler and keyboard coordinate controls in narrow layout.
